title: 第1章 这里不是剧组第2章 放羊的人
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
事故发生的时候，李婉还沉浸在雪山徒步的刺激里，肾上腺素极速飙升，以至于她对脚下松动的碎石毫无察觉。
父母的惊呼声在耳边炸开的瞬间，她整个人已经失重，顿时像断线的风筝一样朝着万丈深渊坠去。
等她反应过来的时候，身体已经穿过一片浓稠无光的暗物质，如流星般划过陌生的天空，然后重重摔在一片柔软的草地上。
李婉庆幸自己常年运动，身体素质还算过关，只是擦破了皮，没摔断骨头。
否则今天她的小命，绝对要丢在这陌生的鬼地方。
撑着胳膊爬起来，环顾一下四周后，李婉愣住了。
眼前的环境陌生得让她有些眩晕。
这是给她干哪里来了？她不是在玉龙雪山和爸妈一起徒步吗？
她记起来了，在她踩空的前一刻，脚下的碎石突然崩落，耳边全是爸妈撕心裂肺的尖叫，她还没反应过来人就到了这里。
李婉警惕四顾。
脚下青石板长街笔直延伸，两侧飞檐翘角、青瓦朱楼，古朴恢弘。
行人皆着宽袖长袍，步履匆匆。
诶？这里的人怎么都穿着古装，我会不会被大风刮到剧组了？
李婉穿着沾满草屑和泥土的冲锋衣，站在一群古装行人里，格格不入。
但是，过了一会儿，当她看到有人脚踩飞剑从头顶掠过时，心里一直悬着的那颗心终于死了。
她也许，大概，可能，好像穿越了！
因为她在持剑飞行的人身上压根没见到威亚！
正当李婉想上前打听一下这里是什么地方的时候，她的眼前突然“叮！”一声，出现了一块半透明的蓝色屏幕。
【最强快递系统已成功绑定！】
【宿主：李婉】

【状态：狼狈沾尘】
【系统功能：星界速通】
【系统标语：地址在手，快递无忧。】
“啊？这什么鬼？”
李婉瞪大了眼，下意识地伸手去抓，却直接穿透了光幕。
“金手指？”
李婉的心脏砰砰直跳，瞬间放弃了打听消息的心思，连忙缩到了一边的角落，开始暗戳戳研究起眼前的这块“屏幕”来。
【系统功能详解】
【功能名称：星界速递】
【功能描述：只要有明确的接收地址和物品，即可将物品瞬间送达至指定地址。】
【当前状态：功能已激活】
鼓捣了半天，李婉终于搞明白了。
这就是个跨界万能快递系统，只要有地址，她就能把东西送到任何地方。
“那我是不是可以……”
李婉的第一反应，就是给家里寄个平安信。
告诉爸妈她没事，还好好活着，既没缺胳膊也没少腿，让她俩别太伤心了，她一定会想办法回去的。
content_en:
When the accident happened, Li Wan was still immersed in the excitement of hiking in the snowy mountains. Her adrenaline was so high that she was unaware of the loose gravel under her feet.
The moment her parents' exclamations exploded in her ears, she lost all weight and fell towards the abyss like a kite with its string broken.
By the time she reacted, her body had passed through a thick, lightless dark matter, streaking across the unfamiliar sky like a meteor, and then fell heavily onto a soft grass.
Li Wan was thankful that she had been exercising all year round and her physical fitness was relatively good. She only scratched her skin and did not break any bones.
Otherwise, her life would definitely be lost in this strange ghost place today.
Li Wan stood up with her arms and looked around, and was stunned.
The unfamiliar environment in front of her made her feel dizzy.
Where did this come from for her? Wasn't she hiking with her parents in Jade Dragon Snow Mountain?
She remembered that the moment before she stepped into the air, the gravel under her feet suddenly collapsed, and her parents' heart-wrenching screams could be heard in her ears. Someone was here before she could react.
Li Wan looked around cautiously.
The long bluestone street stretches straight under your feet, with cornices on both sides and green tiles and red towers, making it simple and majestic.
Pedestrians all wore long robes with wide sleeves and walked in a hurry.
Eh? Why are the people here wearing ancient costumes? Will I be blown to the set by the strong wind?
Li Wan, wearing a jacket stained with grass clippings and dirt, stood out among a group of pedestrians in period costumes, looking out of place.
However, after a while, when she saw someone stepping on a flying sword passing overhead, the heart that had been hanging in her heart finally died.
She might, probably, maybe, seem to have traveled through time!
Because she didn’t see Wia at all on the person flying with the sword!
Just when Li Wan was about to step forward to find out where this place was, there was a sudden "ding!" and a translucent blue screen appeared in front of her eyes.
[The strongest express delivery system has been successfully bound! 】
[Host: Li Wan]
[Status: embarrassed and dusty]
[System Function: Star Boundary Speed Pass]
[System slogan: Address in hand, worry-free express delivery. 】
"Ah? What the hell is this?"
Li Wan's eyes widened and she subconsciously reached out to grab it, but it penetrated the light curtain directly.
"Goldfinger?"
Li Wan's heart was beating fast, and she gave up trying to find out the news. She quickly shrank to a corner and began to secretly study the "screen" in front of her.
[Detailed explanation of system functions]
[Function name: Star Express]
[Function description: As long as there is a clear receiving address and item, the item can be delivered to the designated address instantly. 】
[Current status: Function activated]
After tinkering for a long time, Li Wan finally figured it out.
This is a cross-border universal express delivery system. As long as she has an address, she can send things anywhere.
"Then can I..."
Li Wan's first reaction was to send a safe letter to her family.
Tell her parents that she is fine, that she is still alive and well, that she has neither arms nor legs, and that they should not be too sad. She will definitely find a way to go back.
